name: myliberte/htmlpdf
description: Dependency-free HTML/CSS to PDF renderer for myliberte

suggest.ext-exif: Applies the EXIF rotation of phone photos (used by the dossier builder)
suggest.ext-gd: Lets load GIF, WebP, BMP, interlaced PNG and 16-bit PNG with alpha
suggest.qpdf (system binary): Needed by HtmlPdf\Pdf\Assembler to merge or stamp existing PDFs: sudo apt install qpdf
